SUEQ.description: Seismic Design Scale Factors (SUEQ). Fields set per-value the axial, moment, and shear scale factors applied to seismic load cases and load combinations during steel design.

LC_AXIAL.description: Load Case - Axial scale factor applied to the seismic load case axial force.

LC_MOMENT.description: Load Case - Moment scale factor applied to the seismic load case moment.

LC_SHEAR.description: Load Case - Shear scale factor applied to the seismic load case shear force.

LCOM_AXIAL.description: Load Combination - Axial scale factor applied to the seismic load combination axial force.

LCOM_MOMENT.description: Load Combination - Moment scale factor applied to the seismic load combination moment.

LCOM_SHEAR.description: Load Combination - Shear scale factor applied to the seismic load combination shear force.
